details: Beginning exploration of normalization compute kernels for rms_norm design

Read examples/master.md; identifying entries matching rms_norm DM profile: DRAM interleaved reads, reduce over W, stream/reuse row tiles, write out. Targets: chunk granularity, buffer depth, work-split, reconfig cost, reductions/normalization/streaming.

Mapped catalog entries to rms_norm knobs. Primary: double_buffer (buffer depth block=4-8, 2x depth CBs), compute_block_size (granularity + reconfig ablation 110-150ns/reconfig), row_reduce_accumulate + reduce_block (REDUCE_ROW streaming accumulate), noc_placement (work-split row_wise + NoC0/NoC1), sfpu_tile_scope (rsqrt axis-scope). Noted DM-bound caveats where compute wins do not show.

Production rmsnorm/layernorm ops were nuked. Key refs: test compute kernels (tests/tt_metal/.../compute/{rmsnorm,layernorm}.cpp), deepseek unified rmsnorm.hpp, registry toy ops (toy_variance, toy_reduce_partial) using kernel_lib reduce/streaming helpers + partial-scaler masking, registry op template op_template.py + references/generic_op_template/, golden spec prompts/rms_norm.txt, golden test suite golden_tests/rms_norm/
Located tilize_helpers_dataflow.hpp and toy_tilize_untilize reference op; beginning search for tilize reader/writer and split_work_to_cores precedent
